title: Executable app absent
mitigation_action: Scaffold Next.js/Express/Prisma and CI using fictional orgs
closure_evidence_required: Verified clean clone, running app and real CI run/commit

title: No tests executed
mitigation_action: Implement runners and execute prioritized cases; log failures honestly
closure_evidence_required: Real run IDs, assertion logs, prioritized cases executed, zero untriaged critical defects

title: No runtime tenant/record/field enforcement
mitigation_action: Implement fail-closed guards and run 286 policy decisions and 52 negative-access tests
closure_evidence_required: Executed IDOR, role, revocation, export/aggregate tests and reviewed findings

title: No API or event implementation
risk_consequence: Contract drift, lost or duplicated state
mitigation_action: Build Express schema validation, scoped sessions, CSRF/idempotency, transactional outbox
closure_evidence_required: Actual API/event tests with commit/run artifacts; failure recovery checked

title: UI-only and deferred PRD coverage
risk_consequence: False completeness or accidental provider endpoints
mitigation_action: Test UC-106 UI and UC-208 QA; keep UC-301..306 deferred and unavailable
closure_evidence_required: Explicit approved scope and executed UI/QA/unavailable-route checks

title: No independent feature-level test execution
risk_consequence: Shared test IDs mask unverified feature behaviors
mitigation_action: Add per-feature edge/error scenarios, especially 7 without direct API routes
closure_evidence_required: Executed tests and evidence for each accepted feature, dependencies verified

title: Unvalidated external processor semantics
risk_consequence: Wrong merchant statuses or fabricated approvals
mitigation_action: Validate 3 ISO/POS/PayFac operator workflows, obtain contracts and authenticated status rules
closure_evidence_required: Anonymized operator evidence and approved partner/status mapping

title: Unvalidated customer value/pricing/pilot
mitigation_action: Interview buyers/pricing prospects and obtain pilot commitments; revisit GTM
closure_evidence_required: Real evidence, 5 buyer pricing interviews, 2 pilot commitments or explicit new viability decision

title: Missing privacy/security/legal readiness
mitigation_action: Implement data lifecycle, legal terms/DPAs, secret/log protections and independent security review
closure_evidence_required: Actual reviewed policy/legal/contracts and security findings addressed

title: No measured NFR/backups/accessibility
risk_consequence: Poor reliability, untested disaster recovery, a11y failures
mitigation_action: Run synthetic load, backup restore and keyboard/screen-reader accessibility checks
closure_evidence_required: Measured latency with environment, restore evidence, accessibility results vs targets

title: Provisional entity/API/domain semantics
risk_consequence: Rework, broken associations or unsafe schema
mitigation_action: Freeze opaque IDs, tenant FKs/field projections, lifecycle and configurable internal stages
closure_evidence_required: Reviewed schema decision record, migration tests and cross-tenant negative cases

title: Mock billing and no commercial contracts
risk_consequence: Invalid charges and unsupported commercial terms
mitigation_action: Retain mock billing until provider, taxes/terms, pricing, legal entity approved
closure_evidence_required: Real vendor agreement, documented pricing/terms and verified billing behavior

title: No tested tenant-safe aggregates/exports
risk_consequence: Hidden rows leaked via reports or files
mitigation_action: Enforce pre-aggregation authorization, job/export scopes and revoked access
closure_evidence_required: Real query/report reconciliation, denied foreign count and export test evidence

title: No reproducible audit/CI evidence
risk_consequence: False success or non-reproducible quality claims
mitigation_action: Implement CI evidence schema per case, capture run/commit/fixture/env/status/defect
closure_evidence_required: Redacted actual CI artifact URLs and reviewers' gate decision
